name: Governance Hijack Attempt
summary: Attacker submits a policy proposal that rotates the on-chain PolicyVerifier to a contract that unconditionally returns true. The proposal carries no matching rule — PolicyCompliance fails to prove.
expectedOutcome: Proposal hits api-gateway. PolicyCompliance guest panics (no rule authorises setVerifier). No proof generated. On-chain verifier never sees a receipt. ThreatConfirmedEvent@2 emitted for pattern GOVERNANCE_HIJACK.

steps.text: PolicyCompliance: no rule matches setVerifier — PROOF GENERATION FAILED
Chain saw no receipt. The rotation is blocked by math, not by a watchful admin.
